title: 3678. Smallest Absent Positive Greater Than Average

examples.explanation: The average of nums is (3 + 5) / 2 = 8 / 2 = 4. The smallest absent positive integer greater than 4 is 6.
The average of nums is (-1 + 1 + 2) / 3 = 2 / 3 = 0.667. The smallest absent positive integer greater than 0.667 is 3.
The average of nums is (4 + (-1)) / 2 = 3 / 2 = 1.50. The smallest absent positive integer greater than 1.50 is 2.
